intro: Sometimes a return to the current role is no longer possible. Then you want to find a new direction carefully and in time, for your employee and for you as the employer.

With React2u Restart we look at what someone can still do. With an assessment by a labour expert (arbeidsdeskundige), career guidance and a solid second-track programme (tweede spoor: reintegration with another employer), so that you meet your reintegration obligations under Dutch law.

You want to avoid a wage sanction (loonsanctie) from UWV
